description: Angular component for managing alarm rule conditions in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, dialog interactions, and dynamic text generation based on alarm condition types.

classes.name: AlarmRuleConditionComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for alarm rule condition editing, including form controls, dialog interactions, and dynamic description text.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form model.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback, not implemented.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group with condition and spec controls.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on the input boolean.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's model value and initializes default spec type if necessary.

methods.name: conditionSet
methods.description: Checks if the condition array in the model has any elements.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form, returning an error object if condition is not set.

methods.name: openFilterDialog
methods.description: Opens a dialog for editing the alarm rule condition, updating the model upon dialog close.

methods.name: updateConditionInfo
methods.description: Updates form controls with current model data and refreshes the spec text.

methods.name: updateSpecText
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description of the current alarm condition spec.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the model and propagates changes.
